about_the_game:
Step into the vibrant world of bees with Bee Simulator - Artbook and explore the creative journey behind the game! 🎨

This beautifully crafted, 50+ page collection is a true hive of artistic inspiration. From large outlines to details of the UI, uncover the meticulous work that went into bringing the tiny yet grand world of bees to life! 🐝

Buzz through a gallery of stunning loading screens, detailed storyboards, and immersive environmental designs inspired by the iconic Central Park. Get close to the intricacies of the user interface, icons, and the bees themselves in all their diverse glory.

Revisit the full glossary covering key flora & fauna 🌸 and relive your favorite moments with high-resolution screenshots and vibrant wallpapers to keep the Bee Simulator spirit alive on your desktop!

Whether you're a game art enthusiast, a nature lover, or simply a fan of Bee Simulator, this artbook is a sweet treat worth buzzing about! 🐝
